facts.fact: Angop reports that on 30 July 2026 the Assembleia Nacional approved in generalidade, by 166 votes to none, the request for legislative authorisation for the President to legislate the Regime Jurídico da Assinatura Electrónica e da Certificação Digital, which would set e-signature validity, evidential value and the ICP-Angola; the regime is not yet enacted.
